song.title: Jesus We Enthrone You
song.lyrics:
[V1] .G Em Jesus we enthrone You, .C G We proclaim You our King, . Em Bm. Standing here in the midst of us, .C Am D We raise you up with our praise,
[C1] . G Bm Em-D-C And as we worship, build your throne, . D G Em-D-C And as we worship, build your throne, . D G Em And as we worship, build your throne, . Am D G Come Lord Jesus and take Your place.
song.author: Don Moen, Paul Kyle
